comparison.objective: Hang an electric-fence wire in three insulator slots without conductive contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Long flexible-object routing and support, unlike rigid mandrel alignment, hammering, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Wire occupies all slots, stays at least 1 cm from posts, handle hangs free, and robot releases it.
comparison.reason: Its central ability is deformable routing and clearance maintenance, not insert finishing. No spec versions or additional sag/contact rubric details are supplied.
